clips.title: The story
paras: Palemane Rock is a cavern and campsite nestled into the western mountains of Mulgore. It serves as a primary stronghold for the aggressive Palemane gnoll tribe, posing a continual nuisance and threat to the nearby tauren of Bloodhoof Village.

Situated along the western rim of the grassy plains of Mulgore, Palemane Rock consists of a sprawling open-air encampment fronting a deep, shadowed cavern carved into the mountainside. The Palemane gnolls have claimed both the cave interior and the immediate foothills outside as their territory. Hostile and territorial, these gnolls aggressively defend their den, attacking hunters, travelers, and scouts who wander too close to their rocky haven.
